ctx.x: Heh-heh. I don't know. The only thing I could say... The only thing I ever heard when I was a kid was New Orleans clarinet playing, and I took lessons from them. Was Picou a New Orleans clarinet player? What can you say? Maybe I didn't pick up that style exactly. One thing I can say is that I never tried to copy any of them. If anybody, it would be Fritz.

I asked that, because people have said to me these ridiculous things, about 'Oh, Joe, he's from Baton Rouge,' and they've said the same thing about Sam Lee coming from Napoleonville, and Ory coming from La Place and all that.
